Container.Name: sure-itemizer
Container.Overview:
Splits merchant charges in Sure (we-promise/sure) into the items they paid for, so Sure's AI categorizer can categorize each item. Amazon and Target are supported; other merchants plug in as sources.
Starts in DRY RUN: it shows the splits it would make on its status page and writes nothing to Sure until you set DRY_RUN=false. Splitting needs Sure v0.7.6 or newer.
Connect Amazon from the web UI: your email and password are used once to sign in and never stored, and 2-step codes are entered there too. When the session expires, it notifies the webhook and waits for you to reconnect.

Config.Name: Status page
Config.Description: Status page and Run now button

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: State database and the saved Amazon session

Config.Name: Sure API key
Config.Description: Sure → Settings → API keys, read_write scope

Config.Name: Dry run
Config.Description: true = only show planned splits; false = write them to Sure

Config.Name: Apprise URL
Config.Description: Optional. Where to send notifications (a merchant needs you to sign in again, a run failed), as Apprise URLs: e.g. discord://webhook_id/webhook_token or ntfys://topic. Several can be separated by commas. Formats: https://github.com/caronc/apprise/wiki

Config.Name: Status page URL
Config.Description: Optional. Where you open this page, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8686; used as the link in notifications.

Config.Name: Amazon card last 4
Config.Description: Optional: only use Amazon charges paid with this card

Config.Name: Sure account filter
Config.Description: Optional: Sure account id, or part of its name, holding the Amazon charges

Config.Name: Run times
Config.Description: Comma-separated local times to run daily

Config.Name: Lookback days
Config.Description: How far back to look for unprocessed transactions
